name: Peace Lily
hook: Dramatic droop? Your peace lily is just asking for a drink.

steps.title: Water when the top dries
steps.tip: Water once the top few cm of soil are dry. It droops when thirsty but recovers fast.

steps.title: Bright, indirect light
steps.tip: Give it bright, indirect light near a window, but no direct sun. In deep shade it rarely flowers.

steps.title: Likes moderate humidity
steps.tip: Dry air browns the leaf edges. Stand the pot on a tray of damp gravel, or mist it.

steps.title: Snip spent flowers
steps.tip: Cut faded white blooms and yellow leaves at the base to send energy to new growth.

steps.title: Feed lightly
steps.tip: Use a diluted balanced fertilizer every 6–8 weeks in spring and summer.

outro: Soil dry? Then it's time. That's the whole peace lily trick.

sources.title: RHS: How to grow peace lilies
